production.text:
List Agent runs
Copy page

Retrieve a paginated list of Agent runs for your team.

GET
/
agent
/
runs
Try it
Runs are returned from newest to oldest. Use limit to control page size and cursor with the nextCursor from the previous response to fetch the next page.
Get your Exa API key
Create a key in the dashboard. New accounts start with free credits.
Authorizations
apiKey
bearer
apiKey
​
x-api-key
stringheaderrequired

Pass your Exa API key in the x-api-key header. You can also authenticate with Authorization: Bearer .

Query Parameters
​
limit
integerdefault:20

Number of results per page

Required range: 1 <= x <= 100
​
cursor
string

Cursor for pagination. Use the nextCursor value from the previous run list response.

Required string length: 1 - 200
Pattern: ^[A-Za-z0-9_.:-]+$
Example:

"agent_run_01j7x9v0m2n4p6q8r0s2t4v6w8"

Response
200
application/json

Paginated Agent runs

​
object
stringrequired
Allowed value: "list"
​
data
object[]required

Show child attributes

​
hasMore
booleanrequired

Whether there are more results

​
nextCursor
string | nullrequired

Agent run ID. New run IDs are returned with the agent_run_ prefix.

Required string length: 1 - 200
Pattern: ^[A-Za-z0-9_.:-]+$
Example:

"agent_run_01j7x9v0m2n4p6q8r0s2t4v6w8"
